reading_issues: Height-axis chart with axis break: blue 'PIT 109' line and zig-zag mean the pit bottom is 109 cm above ground (HS 200, 91 cm dug). Heights calibrated on the 10 cm gridlines (13.88 px/cm) with 200 cm at the chart top. Hardness axis is non-uniform (F, 4f, 1f, P, K tick spacing 178, 252, 498, 655 px); bars read by piecewise-linear interpolation between ticks and every layer edge lands on a tick except 140-145 cm (2.65, recorded as 1F-). Grain Form column shows glyphs only, no size column, so size_mm is null. The dome-on-box glyph (square with rounded top and a bar) is read as FCxr per the TRANSCRIBE guide / earlier Bath Glacier reading. CT25SP line is at the top of the pink 138-140 cm layer (140 cm). Header slope 0 deg with aspect NE recorded as printed. Blowing snow 'No Transport'. No temperature profile on the chart.
